g.text: C. Cumulative local prefill execution cost
Execution ms; extra small-batch work and source interference remain charged
CPU-paced units are emitted after real 40M-iteration work; no synthetic sleep window or EOF idle interval.
Complete semantic messages from a local process, not vendor cloud SSE. Burst negatives and producer slowdown retained.
